summary: The first preprint reports 10,359 genes at adjusted P < 0.05. The publication reports 1,407 without identifying the genes or explaining the revised selection rule. The current Explorer table has 10,146 FDR < 0.05 calls, and all 113 named Gly-Low effects in the recovered Table S2 comparison agree in direction. [First preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2022.08.10.503411v1.full) · [Publication](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725011933-mmc5.pdf) · [Table S2](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725011933-mmc4.xlsx)
openIssues: Which GEO libraries, tested gene IDs, DESeq2 design, filtering steps and statistical cutoffs produced the final 1,407 genes? The authors’ per-gene results or generating code would establish how that selection changed after preprint version 1.
GEO and the RNA-seq Methods support the registered four-month cohort, while the Results text says three months. Individual animal and cage assignments remain unspecified.
